question: I’m working on maintained status while my work permit extension is pending. If I travel abroad and return before approval, can I resume work on maintained status?
generated_answer: Yes, if you travel abroad and return before your work permit extension is approved, you can resume work on maintained status. However, it’s crucial to ensure that you return to Canada before the expiry of your current work permit and that you have a valid temporary resident status (e.g., visitor status) to re-enter the country. Upon re-entry, you can continue working on maintained status until a decision is made on your work permit extension application. It’s advisable to consult with an immigration professional to confirm the specifics of your situation and to ensure compliance with all immigration requirements.
